answer: Attacker cost rises sharply since every fake identity needs a fresh stake plus independent verification. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-personhood inlet prior to acting; duplicate identities sharing hardware or biometrics get rejected. A small Zephyr-tier deposit deters casual spam, while a Gale-tier bond is required to vote on governance, making a mass sybil swarm prohibitively expensive to sustain across epochs. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
